final_wiki.Q-4539 GCD of 480 and 570:
The greatest common divisor of 480 and 570 is 30.

Calculation using Euclidean algorithm:
570 = 480 × 1 + 90
480 = 90 × 5 + 30
90 = 30 × 3 + 0

Therefore GCD(480, 570) = 30
